title: ARPI Microsoft Fabric validation result
description: The evidence file scripts/validate_powerbi_fabric.py writes after deploying the committed TMDL definition to a Microsoft Fabric workspace, refreshing it against a cloud PostgreSQL reporting schema, and comparing every governed measure against powerbi/validation/sql_baseline.json. ADR-0008 accepts this as an equal alternative to Power BI Desktop validation: the engine differs, the proof obligation does not. scripts/check_fabric_validation_freshness.py reads it in CI. A result is only believable while model_source_hash still matches the committed semantic model - a model that was validated and then edited has no valid evidence, and CI reports that as STALE rather than as passed. Nothing here may record a token, a password or a credential-bearing connection string; a workspace ID and an item ID are identifiers, not secrets.

validated_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 instant the validation ran. Null when it has never run.

operator.description: Who ran the validation, as free text they chose - a GitHub handle is the usual answer. Recorded because the gate is a human's attestation. Never an email address, a machine name or a domain account.

engine.description: Named explicitly so a reader of the file alone knows which of ADR-0008's two paths produced it.

workspace_id.description: Fabric workspace GUID the model was deployed to. An identifier, not a secret.

model_source_hash.description: SHA-256 over the committed semantic model definition, from scripts/check_desktop_validation_freshness.py --print-hash. One implementation, shared by both engines.

retrieved_definition_hash.description: SHA-256 over the definition read back from the service with getDefinition, when it was captured. Null when the round trip was not performed in the same run. scripts/deploy_powerbi_fabric.py performs the comparison itself and fails on any unexplained difference.

table_count.description: Tables the ENGINE reports, not the TMDL.

imported_table_count.description: Imported source tables the ENGINE reports. Expected 20.

measure_table_count.description: Measure tables the ENGINE reports, identified by the ' Measures' name suffix. Expected 6.

row_counts.description: Rows loaded per imported table, compared against model_expectations.json.

sql_to_dax_differences.description: Every measure whose DAX value differed from the SQL baseline beyond tolerance. Empty is the only acceptable state for a passed result.

overall_result.description: 'pending' means Fabric has never validated this model. It is not a pass, and no CI check may render it as one.
